newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq closes at 3rd record for month.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq closes at 3rd record for month.

text.p: A rally in shares of semiconductor equipment companies propelled the Nasdaq Composite Index to its third record close this month.
The index was up 16.16 points, or 1.28 percent, at 1274.24 at its unofficial close. Advancers led decliners by about 12 to nine on volume of about 675 million shares.
The previous record was set on November 14, when the index rose 9.64 to close at 1270.36.
"All the trends on Nasdaq are positive. The index is extended, but not at extreme levels," said Alfred Goldman, technical analyst at A.G. Edwards & Sons.
"There is no near-term resistance and the first support is down at 1250. We are seeing very impressive action."

The rally was sparked by sector flagship Applied Materials Inc. Applied Materials that even at the low point in the current cycle, the company expects its profit-margins to remain higher than in previous market cycles.
Applied Materials, the most actively traded Nasdaq issue, was up 6-5/8 at 38-5/8. Other winners included Novellus Systems Inc, up 9-49/64 to 59-3/4, and Lam Research Corp, up 4-9/16 to 34-1/16.
